name: Pantomime
overview: Scripture reveals that God used pantomime as a prophetic sign to communicate His messages vividly. Isaiah walked naked and barefoot for three years as a visible warning against Egypt and Ethiopia, demonstrating the seriousness of God's judgment (Isaiah 20:2-3). Similarly, Ezekiel employed symbolic actions by portraying Jerusalem on a tile, laying siege to it, and lying on his side to bear Israel’s iniquity, thus embodying God’s judgment and the burden of sin (Ezekiel 4:1-4). These acts, directed by the Spirit, served as tangible illustrations of divine truth for the people of Israel.
